scope: Existing 93 cards matched to the owner MTI projection price; live snapshot. No product updates.
method: HTTP GET, MIME and image header dimensions; at most 256 KiB per URL. Full-body hashes only for files that finished within that limit. Visual model correctness and full image decode are not inferred. Three initial exceptions were fetched in full and decoded with Pillow. One timeout cleared on that focused recheck. Identical files across different models are review candidates, not proof of a wrong product photo.
